lines.text: Many learners say: I go to the library to buy books.
Better: I go to the bookstore to buy books.
A library lends books. A bookstore sells them.
Bookstore! I buy books at the bookstore.

data.wrong: I go to the library to buy books.
data.right: I go to the bookstore to buy books.
data.why: A library lends books. A bookstore sells them.

native.tip: « Library » veut dire {m:library}. Pour acheter un livre, on va dans « a bookstore ».
native.caption: Attention, faux ami ! 😬 « Library » signifie {m:library}, pas librairie. Pour acheter des livres, dis “I go to the bookstore”. Écoute Ama et répète avec elle ! Plus d'exercices dans l'appli Lexkite.
native.comment: Réponse : “bookstore”. Une bibliothèque prête des livres, une librairie les vend. Teste d'autres faux amis avec un quiz gratuit : {link}

en.tip: “Library” means bibliothèque. To buy a book, you go to “a bookstore”.
en.caption: Watch out, false friend! “Library” means bibliothèque, not librairie. To buy books, say “I go to the bookstore”. Listen to Ama and repeat with her! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
